fullDescription.text: Data corruption or tampering in NoSQLDatabase via unauthorized write access
Unauthorized privilege escalation on ObjectStorage due to misconfiguration or vulnerability
Unauthorized access to sensitive data stored in NoSQLDatabase leading to data breach
Unauthorized privilege escalation on CDNEdge due to misconfiguration or vulnerability
Critical Elevation of Privilege: Unauthenticated data flow from LambdaFunction is allowed to interact with a critical database NoSQLDatabase.
Unpatched OS or software vulnerabilities on ObjectStorage leading to system compromise
Weak or missing authentication on routes managed by API Gateway APIGateway, allowing unauthorized access to backend services.
Unpatched OS or software vulnerabilities on CDNEdge leading to system compromise
Data interception on an unencrypted channel from APIGateway to LambdaFunction (Man-in-the-Middle attack)
Data interception on an unencrypted channel from LambdaFunction to NoSQLDatabase (Man-in-the-Middle attack)
Data interception on an unencrypted channel from LambdaFunction to ObjectStorage (Man-in-the-Middle attack)
Data interception on an unencrypted channel from Developer/Cloud Operator to APIGateway (Man-in-the-Middle attack)
Privilege abuse by actor End User to gain unauthorized access or perform unauthorized actions
Privilege abuse by actor Developer/Cloud Operator to gain unauthorized access or perform unauthorized actions
Potential for spoofing attacks on data crossing trust boundaries from APIGateway to LambdaFunction without proper authentication
Denial of Service against NoSQLDatabase through resource-intensive queries or excessive connections
Improper rate limiting on API Gateway APIGateway, leading to Denial of Service.
Insecure security configuration or hardening on ObjectStorage leading to information exposure
Invocation flood on serverless function LambdaFunction exhausting its concurrency limit and driving up cost (denial of wallet)
Insecure security configuration or hardening on CDNEdge leading to information exposure
Lack of monitoring or logging on ObjectStorage, preventing detection of malicious activities and enabling repudiation
No audit trail of data changes in NoSQLDatabase, so modifications cannot be attributed to a user
Spoofing of data from End User to CDNEdge due to lack of authentication
Spoofing of data from CDNEdge to APIGateway due to lack of authentication
Spoofing of data from APIGateway to LambdaFunction due to lack of authentication
Spoofing of data from LambdaFunction to NoSQLDatabase due to lack of authentication
Spoofing of data from LambdaFunction to ObjectStorage due to lack of authentication
Spoofing of data from Developer/Cloud Operator to APIGateway due to lack of authentication
Identity spoofing of the actor End User via phishing or credential theft
Identity spoofing of the actor Developer/Cloud Operator via phishing or credential theft
Lack of monitoring or logging on CDNEdge, preventing detection of malicious activities and enabling repudiation
Repudiation of critical actions performed by End User due to insufficient logging or non-repudiation controls
Repudiation of critical actions performed by Developer/Cloud Operator due to insufficient logging or non-repudiation controls
